% generated by experiments/e2_ground_truth.py
Median over 20 replications (Spearman: median [min, max]) of the agreement between a learned score and the exact log-likelihood ratio $\log p(w)/q(w)$ on fresh windows (half from each law). Cal. slope: OLS slope of the score on the exact value (1 for a calibrated log-likelihood ratio). RMSE and Accuracy (rule score $>0$) only for the LR-critic logit, whose optimum with balanced classes is $\log p/q$; the W-critic is identified only up to scale and shift. Steps: early-stopping checkpoint selected (median) or steps run. GARCH comparison: window density integrated over the start variance by Monte Carlo.
